issue: Support `connection.sni` in AuthorizationPolicy for waypoint proxy [closed; labels kind/enhancement, area/networking, area/security, area/ambient]
**Describe the feature request**

I've been looking at setting up ambient mode and using a waypoint proxy for egress traffic, however when I try to set up ServiceEntries using `protocol: TLS`, there doesn't seem to be any good way to apply an AuthorizationPolicy to restrict based on the different service entries. It seems like the condition `connection.sni` does not work with the waypoint proxy.
